correctness.rationale: In the Hillar-Rhea matrix model, reduction modulo p is block upper triangular by cyclic exponent, and an endomorphism is invertible exactly when its reduction modulo p is. Thus a finite abelian p-group automorphism is fixed-point-free exactly when every same-exponent diagonal block has no eigenvalue 1. The diagonal-block reduction map is surjective with uniform fibers, giving the product count; Möbius inversion on the subspace lattice gives the stated GL_m derangement formula.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The 2018 paper proves only the rank-two distinct-exponent fixed-point-free count and poses the higher-rank theta-value problem. Hillar-Rhea give the automorphism matrix model and total count, Gross gives the abelian 2-group existence criterion, and Senden determines which fixed-point cardinalities occur. Targeted searches did not locate the general exact product formula, the partition closed form, or the all-rank distinct-exponent d=1 formula.

value.rationale: The result uniformly counts fixed-point-free automorphisms for every finite abelian group, settles the d=1 slice of an explicit 2018 all-rank problem, and refines a classical abelian 2-group existence criterion into an exact enumeration.
